cascades_or_tumbles.how_it_works:
point is added to the Snake progress meter. The remaining symbols drop down and new symbols drop in to fill the symbol grid. If new winning combinations occur, this avalanche repeats.
Snake progress meter
The Snake progress meter has 4 levels. All winning symbols add progress to the meter. Activating any of the levels will release snakes to enter the grid.
Level 1: 1 snake enters
Level 2: 2 snakes enter

wilds.name: Wild
wilds.behavior: The Wild symbol substitutes for any paying symbol.

base_game_loop.summary: Coba: paid spin on 7x7. Cluster wins (5 connecting symbol clusters). Avalanche/tumble after wins. Round ends on win cap if reached.

phases.name: Place bet and spin
phases.what_happens: Player selects bet and hits Spin (or Auto Spin). Optional: activate an X-iter mode from base game only before the drop/spin.
phases.state_changes: Bet locked; optional X-iter mode selected

phases.name: Initial symbol drop/spin
phases.what_happens: Symbols land on 7x7. Game-specific setup features may fire (birds, Nitro/COOL reels, collectors, etc.).
phases.ends_when: All symbols at resting positions / reels stopped

phases.name: Evaluate wins
phases.what_happens: Evaluate wins: Cluster wins (5 connecting symbol clusters)

phases.name: Remove winners and Avalanche
phases.what_happens:
point is added to the Snake progress meter. The remaining symbols drop down and new symbols drop in to fill the symbol grid. If new winning combinations occur, this avalanche repeats.
Snake progress meter
The Snake progress meter has 4 levels. All winning symbols add progress to the meter. Activating any of the levels will release snakes to enter the grid.
Level 1: 1 snake enters
Level 2: 2 snakes enter
Level 3: 3 snakes enter
Level 4: 6 snakes enter
A snake is a linear cluster of symbols movin
phases.ends_when: No new winning combinations after a fill
phases.state_changes: Grid updated; avalanche chain may continue

phases.name: End-of-drop features
phases.what_happens: Resolve end-of-round features (bombs, mystery reveals, row swaps, boosters, etc.) if nothing else can happen; may resume avalanches.

phases.name: Bonus trigger check
phases.what_happens: If bonus/super-bonus trigger conditions met, enter bonus mode after resolving same-drop features. Otherwise settle base-game wins subject to win cap.
phases.state_changes: Enter bonus mode or settle base round

Game description
Deep inside in the Mexican jungle lies the mysterious COBA temple of the worshiped snake god Quetzalcoatl. The temple is protected by his snakes and temple traps. Your goal is to climb the temple and level up rewarded by snakes entering the grid, which will help with larger win clusters and Multiplying Wild Multipliers.

 COBA is a cluster game with symbol win explosions and symbol gravity to keep the game going.

is a 7 rows and 6-7 columns slot with a hexagonal symbol grid with cluster wins, dropping symbols and a snake feature of walking clusters.

X-iter rules
The X-iter feature offers several different game modes.
COBA!:

Winnings are collected towards level ups where "walking cluster" snakes enter the game alone or in larger groups. The snakes eat symbols to grow and stay alive to create even larger win clusters for big win crescendos, over and over again.
